The guidelines for API guides in `docs/api/howtos` live in the agent skill
[`writing-api-guides`](../../.agents/skills/writing-api-guides/SKILL.md). Read that file and follow
it.

It is the single source of truth for front matter, document structure, the `<OperationLink />`,
`<OperationExample />`, `<OperationHint />` and `<SchemaFromSpec />` components, placeholder
conventions and request/response documentation.

Also follow the general documentation guidelines in the
[`writing-documentation`](../../.agents/skills/writing-documentation/SKILL.md) skill.
